summary: Tower named Ellerbe in Richmond County. A 1993 NGS benchmark description places Millstone Fire Tower in view, possibly the same site. No site record found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The list calls the tower Ellerbe. The 1993 benchmark description names a Millstone Fire Tower visible from the mark. By our rough calculation the listed Ellerbe coordinates lie about 600 m from the mark, on a bearing of about 168 degrees, close to the 167-degree azimuth the description gives. The sources do not say the two names are one tower, so the story leaves both open.

notes_for_editor: Two readable sources only. Neither gives a build date, height, design, staffing or fate for a tower at Ellerbe, so the record has no events and no facts beyond the list entry. A digitalnc photo record, 'Two Views of Ellerbe Tower and Road Approach' (dated 1942-02-05 in a search snippet, with the subject Towers and coverage Ellerbe, Richmond County), returned no text from the cache at either URL tried (records 18643 and 18701), so it is not cited; a person should read it by hand, since it may show a tower at Ellerbe in 1942. The about-600-metre distance and 168-degree bearing are our own calculation from the two sets of coordinates. Property listings show a Fire Tower Rd in Ellerbe; that is a street name only and is not used. Two WebSearch calls were made.
